value.rationale: Twenty canonical projective D5 roots offer 15-parameter minimal exact quadratic reconstruction. All 5184 invertible 15-sample designs share D-optimal determinant, but separate into three distinct noise-amplification bounds, with exactly 2304 sharp E-optimal selections from two intrinsic graph geometries. This is a natural complete spectral classification rather than a numerical check or arbitrary small invariant.
